subject: C16
required_fixes: R1 — Bind model state and asynchronous replies to the integration being displayed. In apps/desktop/src/features/gateway/gateway-view.tsx:433, InventoryPanel reuses DetailPanel when another row is opened; DetailPanel:453 retains models across that change, and readModels:460-464 commits a reply without checking which integration is current. Reading models for A and then opening B without closing details displays A's models under B; starting A's model read, opening B, and completing A does the same. Both cases reproduced in an in-memory render of the source component. This violates C16's freshness requirement and misrepresents B's supported models. Acceptance: exercise both transitions through the production App/DesktopClient interface with two integrations; B must show no A model data, loading state or failure, late A replies must be discarded, and reading B must display only B's result. Include regression evidence for the corrected interaction.

R2 — Make the advertised workspace detail readable from the Gateway UI. apps/desktop/src/features/gateway/gateway-view.tsx:29-38 excludes workspaces from every detail-capable tab, and :262-277 renders workspace choices only as name/slug radio buttons. No control or read path requests Detail { resource: 'workspaces', id }, so the implemented workspace GET, including defaults and embedded usage/rate limits, is inaccessible to an operator. C16 milestone 1 covers configuration/limits reads, and this packet specifically claims embedded workspace-detail limits are shown; the wire test calls this operation directly but does not establish a usable application flow. Acceptance: provide an accessible read-only path for the selected workspace's projected detail, with loading/denied/error states and correct retirement on selection/context changes; verify defaults and embedded limits through App/DesktopClient tests and native keyboard/focus evidence. This does not require the separate limit-policy APIs deferred to C18.
limitations: Independently recomputed all four supplied fingerprints and verified 547 source-inventory entries and 280 referenced hashes, including run outputs/artifacts. The passing predecessor receipt chain contains 20 records. Hash consistency establishes input binding, not independent authorship of recorded results.
